messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from yesterday's billing postmortem — putting owners + timelines here for the delayed metering / token-count mismatch incident. We need clear owners for remediation, customer invoice corrections, and a recurring check to catch regressions.

ajay: TL;DR root cause was an ingestion backpressure window that dropped ~3% of raw usage events between 02:15–02:42 UTC; aggregator later reprocessed some but counts were truncated. Working theory: flow control bug + retry dedupe race.

maria: Action list I propose: 1) Fix ingestion backpressure logic (SRE) 2) Backfill missing events and reconcile token counts (Billing) 3) Publish corrected invoices / credit notes (Finance) 4) Add recurring data-quality alert + dashboard (Platform) 5) Customer comms template + timeline (Support/CS). Assignments? :point_down: :spiral_calendar_pad:

ajay: I can own 1 — target hotfix + canary by EOD Thu, full rollout next Tue. Will open PR and link.

taylor: I’ll take 2 and 3 (billing-engineer). Need a clear reconciliation query and a list of affected customers. Will need ~2 days once we get raw event dump.

sara: I’ll draft the customer comms template. Recommend offering pro-rated credits for impacted invoices and include ETA for corrected invoice.

kevin: For 4 I’ll add a daily DQ job and a per-hour anomaly alert. Proposed checks: total tokens ingested vs tokens emitted per model, and ingest latency spikes.

maria: Nice. Please record tasks in the postmortem doc and link to the tracker. Also add expected owner ETA fields.

ajay: Opened GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/8421 — includes logs and initial debug notes.

ajay: Patch in progress — fix adjusts token-batch flush and backoff thresholds. Local tests show no drops on synthetic spike. Will push canary at 2023-11-16T18:00Z.

taylor: Reconciliation query (first draft):
```sql
-- counts by customer from raw_events (ingest_ts) vs billing_aggregate (billing_day)
SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(raw.tokens) as raw_tokens, SUM(bill.tokens) as billed_tokens
FROM raw_events raw
JOIN customers c ON raw.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN billing_aggregate bill ON bill.customer_id = c.id AND bill.day = DATE(raw.ingest_ts)
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING ABS(SUM(raw.tokens) - COALESCE(SUM(bill.tokens),0)) > 1000;
```
I’ll run once ajay hands the raw dump.

maria: For invoicing, target draft credit notes ready by Fri COB. Support to send initial heads-up today and follow with corrected invoices next week.

kevin: Added dashboard PR: https://grafana.redwood/boards/du-123 — includes hourly ingest vs billing delta. Will enable alerting at 5%+ delta sustained for 2 hours.

incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem follow-up due in 7 days (2023-11-23). Please update action statuses.

sara: Draft comms in #support-drafts pinned. @maria please review before sending.

maria: One more: product requested root-cause timeline for exec summary. ajay can you produce a short timeline (timestamps of error window, mitigation steps) by EOD tomorrow?

ajay: On it — will include metrics snapshots and logs.

maria: Cool. Owners/ETAs recap: ajay (ingest fix) EOD Thu canary, Tue full; taylor (reconcile + invoices) 2 days after raw dump; kevin (DQ + alerts) in prod by Mon; sara (customer comms) initial note today, credits by Fri. I’ll follow up in 48h and close loop. :white_check_mark:

kevin: One note — recurring pattern: we saw similar latency spikes in June and Aug (ish). I’ll add a runbook link and mark as recurring-incident to track trend.

maria: Good catch. Add incident tags and recurrence notes in the postmortem doc. If anyone needs extra help ping me.

ajay: Ack. Will attach canary rollout logs and the patched diff to the postmortem doc when done.

maria: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as single source for follow-ups — please update status in the GH issue and postmortem doc.

sara: Ack :thumbsup:

kevin: Ack :eyes:
